dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Where are the toothbrushes?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈwɛr ər ðə ˈtuːθbrʌʃɪz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They're over there, next to the toothpaste.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr, ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈtuːθpeɪst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you! And where's the shampoo?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ənd ˈwɛrz ðə ʃæmˈpuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Shampoo and soap are on the left.
dialogue.reading: ʃæmˈpuː ənd ˈsoʊp ər ɑːn ðə ˈlɛft.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Look, Emma! This comb is only twenty baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk, ˈɛmə! ðɪs ˈkoʊm ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛnti ˈbɑːt.
